tools.name: search
tools.description: Find figures about injury lawsuits (one sourced figure each), datasets and law firm profiles by words: a subject, a measure, a state, a firm. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Example: "plaintiff win rate at trial Texas", "Morgan & Morgan".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one search result: the figure in a sentence with its place, period, label and source, how it was calculated, the known limits, the page and the credit line.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: The newsroom's findings (one figure in a sentence each), for the nation, one of the states covered, or New York City, and optionally one kind of case.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: One finding as data: figure, statement, label (Sourced, Computed or Estimated), sources with the date retrieved and reuse terms, how it was calculated, limits, credit line, page and CSV.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: The datasets in the data library with their files, columns and row counts: federal injury cases by court, state and year, class actions, multidistrict litigation, judges, tort claim payments and more. Filter by words.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Rows of one CSV file from the data library, filtered by column values. Use list_datasets to get a file path and its columns. Returns at most 200 rows a call; use offset for more.

tools.name: get_case_outcomes
tools.description: Every published figure for one place and kind of case: cases filed and closed, trials, plaintiff wins at trial, the share settled and days to closing, each with its label and source. Without a year: the latest year and multi-year figures.

tools.name: get_law_firm_profile
tools.description: What named public sources state about one of 203 injury, mass tort and class action law firms: founding, offices, kinds of case, slogan and reported results. Each row says who states it. Not a rating; a firm's claims are not checked.

tools.name: how_to_cite
tools.description: The credit line, the underlying sources and their reuse terms for a finding, a dataset or a law firm profile.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
